meta.title: Impact - CARE in the Field
meta.description: CARE impact across Kerala Palliative Care, TeleICU, CARE HMIS deployments, open-source contributors, and Digital Public Good validation.

hero.title: Open healthcare infrastructure, proven in care delivery.
hero.body: CARE is no longer only a promising open-source project. It is running palliative care, critical care, hospital workflows, and public-good infrastructure across real health systems.

programs.title: One core. Many care delivery systems.
programs.body: These are not separate products. They are deployment patterns built on the same open healthcare operating layer.

palliative.title: A statewide grid for home-based care.
palliative.text: CARE powers daily operations across primary care centers, NGOs, clinicians, and field teams serving patients who need continuity beyond the hospital.

teleicu.title: Specialist critical care, extended through open infrastructure.
teleicu.text: CARE supports hub-and-spoke ICU workflows across hospitals, states, patients, and daily clinical users.

hmis.title: A modern HMIS layer already live across multiple deployments.
hmis.text: CARE HMIS 3.0 supports hospital workflows across registration, encounters, notes, orders, labs, pharmacy, billing, reporting, and analytics.

map.title: Deployment proof should be visible, navigable, and current.
map.body: The map shows where CARE-powered programs have run across public health, hospitals, critical care, and community care. The 2026 updates page carries the current narrative as deployments mature.

validation.title: Public-good signals that outlast any one program.
validation.body: OHC's impact is not only the software running in the field. It is the open-source community, licence, standards discipline, and external validation that make CARE reusable.

dpg.label: Verified Digital Public Good
dpg.detail: CARE is listed in the DPGA registry and was last evaluated on {date}.

mit.label: MIT licensed
mit.detail: The core remains reusable for governments, hospitals, NGOs, and implementation partners.

community.label: Open-source community
community.detail: {count} code contributors have helped build the CARE ecosystem on GitHub.

final.title: The point is not one deployment. It is reusable capacity.
final.body: CARE gives health systems a shared operating layer they can adapt, own, and extend. OHC Foundation exists to keep that layer open, governed, and ready for the next program.
